abilities.name: Peerless Manoeuvres
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Vanguard Chamber unit that did not use a Move ability this turn and is not in combat.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Ancient Aura
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ruination Chamber unit.
abilities.effect: That unit has Ward (5+) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Synchronised Strikes
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Warrior Chamber units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly non-Hero non-Beast Stormcast Eternals units that do not have the Warrior Chamber keyword.

abilities.name: Oncoming Storm
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Extremis Chamber unit that charged this turn.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit has Strike-first for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Cycle of the Storm
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Sacrosanct Chamber unit that had models slain in this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Return 1 slain model to the target unit.

abilities.name: Heavens-sent
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Unique Stormcast Eternals Infantry or Cavalry unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Their Finest Hour
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals unit that has not used this ability this battle to use this ability
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for that unit's combat attacks and add 1 to save rolls for that unit.

abilities.name: Scions of the Storm
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals unit that is in the Celestial Realm.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: The Celestial Realm
abilities.declare: If there are more friendly Stormcast Eternals units on the battlefield than there are set up in reserve, pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals unit that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in the Celestial Realm. It has now been deployed.

powers.name: Lightning Blast
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals Wizard to cast this spell, then pick the closest visible enemy unit to them that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target. If 2 or more visible enemy units are tied to be the closest, you can pick which is the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

powers.name: Starfall
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy Infantry or Cavalry unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

powers.name: Thundershock
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals Wizard to cast this spell, picka visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

powers.name: Bless Weapons
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Stormcast Eternals Infantry unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 12+, this ability affects all visible friendly Stormcast Eternals units wholly within 12" of the chanter.

powers.name: Translocation
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Stormcast Eternals unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the battle round.

powers.name: Healing Storm
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Stormcast Eternals unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: Heal (D3) the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, Heal (D3) each visible friendly Stormcast Eternals unit wholly within 12" of the chanter instead.

abilities.name: Burning Vengeance
abilities.declare: If this Manifestation was summoned this phase, pick any number of enemy units within 6" of it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Arcane Disruption
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy Wizards while they are within 12" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Everblaze Comet
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Everblaze Comet on the battlefield, pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Everblaze Comet wholly within 18" of the caster.

abilities.name: Tornado of Magic
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks made by enemy units while they are within 12" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Celestian Vortex
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Celestian Vortex on the battlefield, pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Celestian Vortex wholly within 18" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Arcane Enhancement
abilities.effect: While the unit that was picked to be the target of the 'Summon Dais Arcanum' ability is on the platform of this Manifestation: • That unit has Ward (5+) and Fly. • If that unit is a Wizard, add 1 to that unit's power level. • That unit cannot use Move abilities and remains on this Manifestation each time it moves. • If that unit is picked to make a pile-in move, move this Manifestation instead. • Instead of measuring range or visibility to that unit, measure to this Manifestation instead. • This Manifestation cannot be picked to be the target of abilities other than Banish abilities. If this Manifestation is banished, before removing it from the battlefield, set up the unit on its platform on the battlefield within 3" of it. That unit can only be set up in combat with units it was already in combat with when this Manifestation was banished. If it is not possible to set up that unit, it is destroyed. If the unit on the platform is removed from the battlefield, immediately remove this Manifestation from play.

summon.name: Summon Dais Arcanum
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Dais Arcanum on the battlefield, pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals Wizard to cast this spell, pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals Infantry Hero that does not have Fly and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Dais Arcanum within 1/2" of the target, visible to the caster and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and place it on the platform of that Dais Arcanum.

abilities.name: Scything Blade
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see 'The Pendulum Swings'). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Pendulum Swings
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot use Charge or Fight abilities. In addition, when this Manifestation moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing

summon.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulumon the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Mechanisms of Time
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If there are any friendly Wizards within 3" of this Manifestation, pick 1 of the following effects: *Increase Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation. *Decrease Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Wizards while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Chronomantic Cogs
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Dancing Blades
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this Manifestation's attacks.

summon.name: Summon Quicksilver Swords
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Quicksilver Swords endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Harbinger of Horror
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this Manifestation's shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of models in the target unit that were slain this phase, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

summon.name: Summon Horrorghast
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Horrorghast endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Horrorghast endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Traverse the Tides of Death
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Infantry Wizard Hero within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield within 3" of this Manifestation and not in combat. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Lauchon the Soulseeker
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Translocation
abilities.effect: Pick a part of this Manifestation, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Ensnaring Soul-drain
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a Move ability while it is within 9" of any parts of this Manifestation, the effects of the 'Fly' ability do not apply to that unit. Enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of either part of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Shards of Valagharr
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Shards of Valagharr endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Shards of Valagharr endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Shards of Valagharr endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Deathly Passage
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of one part of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the other part of this Manifestation and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

summon.name: Summon Soulscream Bridge
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulscream Bridge endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Soulscream Bridge wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulscream Bridge has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Devourer of Magics
abilities.effect: If this Manifestation destroyed any enemy Manifestations this turn, Heal (6) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Arcane Predator
abilities.effect: You can add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this Manifestation, to a maximum of 3, while it is within 18" of any enemy Manifestations, but if you do so, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of an enemy Manifestation.

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation is targeted by the 'Banish Manifestation' ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

summon.name: Summon Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Morbid Detonation
abilities.declare: You must, and can only, use this ability if this unit has 6 maelstrom points. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this Manifestation is destroyed.

abilities.name: Necrotic Vortex
abilities.effect: Give this Manifestation 1 maelstrom point each time: • This Manifestation is set up. • A unit successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this Manifestation. • A model is slain within 12" of this Manifestation. This Manifestation can have a maximum of 6 maelstrom points at once.

summon.name: Summon Malevolent Maelstrom
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: End Given Form
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Pull of the Nadir
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for friendly and enemy units while they are within 3" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Purple Sun of Shyish
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Bound for the Great Oubliette
abilities.declare: For each part of this Manifestation, you can pick an enemy unit within 3" of that part to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • Subtract a number of inches equal to the roll from the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

summon.name: Summon Soulsnare Shackles
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulsnare Shackles endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: Pulled to the Grave
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can pick an enemy unit that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the target. Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Suffocating Gravetide
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Tendrils of Light and Shadow
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of either part of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play. Each time this Manifestation moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other. Each part of this Manifestation is armed with Tendrils of Light and Shadow.

summon.name: Summon Geminids of Uhl-Gysh
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizardto cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot be targeted by shooting attacks. In addition, a unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is impossible to draw a straight line from a model in the attacking unit to a model in the target unit without that line passing across this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Prismatic Palisade
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Prismatic Palisade endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Prismatic Palisade wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Arcane Passage
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Wizard within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: The next time the target uses a non-Summon Spell ability this phase, add 1 to the casting value of that spell. When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this Manifestation instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this Manifestation instead of to the caster for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.

summon.name: Summon Umbral Spellportal
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Umbral Spellportal endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Umbral Spellportal wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. An Umbral Spellportal has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Restored Vigour
abilities.effect: Heal (3) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Bounteous Healing
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Heal (3) the target.

summon.name: Summon Emerald Lifeswarm
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Ravening Hunger
abilities.declare: If this Manifestation charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation uses a Shoot ability, after that ability has been resolved, allocate 1 damage point to this Manifestation (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

abilities.name: Null Pendant
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 5 from the target's control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Quicksilver Draught
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: This unit has Strike-first for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Mirrorshield
abilities.effect: This unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 9" of it.

abilities.name: Staunch Defender
abilities.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective in friendly territory, add 3 to the control scores of friendly Stormcast Eternals units contesting that objective.

abilities.name: Envoy of the Heavens
abilities.declare: If a friendly Stormcast Eternals unit was destroyed in the previous turn, pick a visible friendly Stormcast Eternals unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has Ward (5+) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Shock and Awe
abilities.effect: Each time this unit is set up using the 'Scions of the Storm' ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the battle round. In addition, each time a friendly Stormcast Eternals unit is set up wholly within 12" of this unit using the 'Scions of the Storm' ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Uncaged Lightning
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit in combat with this unit moves or is removed from the battlefield, after that ability has been resolved, if that enemy unit is on the battlefield and not in combat with this unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Veterans of Amberstone Watch
abilities.effect: Enemy units do not have the Strike-first keyword while they are in combat with this unit. Designer's Note: *Enemy units that have* Strike-last *would still have* Strike-last; *they would not be treated as having neither* Strike-first *nor* Strike-last*.*

abilities.name: Pyrotechnic Souls
abilities.effect: When this unit is destroyed, gain 3 rage dice.

abilities.name: Step Into the Storm
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Monster Stormcast Eternals unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 6" of this terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Lightning Pulse
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If you picked 1 unit, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target. If you picked 2 units, inflict 2 mortal damage on each target. If you picked 3 units, inflict 1 mortal damage on each target.

abilities.name: Thunderous Pounce
abilities.effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for friendly Sacrosanct Chamber Cavalry units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Soul Energy of the First Host
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Sacrosanct Chamber unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Pyroelectric Blast
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target, then inflict 1 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within 3" of the target.

abilities.name: Comet Trail
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Thunderhead Crown
abilities.effect: Heal (3) this unit.

abilities.name: Cometstrike Sceptre
abilities.effect: Each time this unit attacks with its Cometstrike Sceptre, if the attack scores a hit, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Retribution From on High
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is in the Celestial Realm.
abilities.effect: Subtract the current battle round number from 10 to determine this unit's strike zone. Set up this unit on the battlefield more than a number of inches equal to its strike zone from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Monstrous Challenge
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Monster in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn: • Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's Stardrake's Cavernous Jaws for attacks that target that enemy Monster. • If that enemy Monster is also a Hero, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's Templar Weapons for attacks that target that unit.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Stardrake's Cavernous Jaws is 4.

abilities.name: Aura of Purity
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, friendly Stormcast Eternals units have Ward (5+) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Saintly Assault
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly Stormcast Eternals Infantry units wholly within 6" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn: • Add 1 to charge rolls for the targets. • Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' melee weapons.

abilities.name: Once More, For Sigmar, Charge!
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and another visible friendly Warrior Chamber unit within 3" of it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, when making charge rolls for the targets, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

abilities.name: Sigmarite Thundershield
abilities.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.

units.name: Ionus Cryptborn, Warden of Lost Souls

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Cthorak's Ancient Claws is 4.

abilities.name: Lightning Tempest
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be struck by lightning, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit, then roll a dice. On a 1-2, the sequence ends. On a 3+, pick another enemy unit within 3" of that unit to be struck by lightning and inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another enemy unit within 6" of that unit instead of 3". Keep rolling dice in this way until the sequence ends or there are no other enemy units eligible to be struck by lightning. A unit cannot be struck by lightning more than once per turn.

abilities.name: Spirit-scouring Flames
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit's Spirit-scouring Flames to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has the Soulburned keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Soulburned
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed. Pick any number of Soulburned enemy units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Prayer of the Witness
abilities.declare: Make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time a friendly Ruination Chamber unit uses a Fight ability while it is wholly within 18" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved: • Heal (D3) that unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, Heal (3) that unit instead. • That unit has Ward (6+) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

abilities.name: Draconic Onslaught
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Averon Stormsire
abilities.effect: While this unit's Averon Stormsire is on the battlefield, it has Wizard (1).

abilities.name: Overwhelming Storm
abilities.declare: If this unit is contesting an objective that you control, pick a friendly non-Hero Stormcast Eternals Infantry unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks.

abilities.name: Celestial Blaze
abilities.effect: When this unit uses the 'Power Through' command, inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on the target and add D6" to the distance this unit can move as part of that ability

abilities.name: Azyr Unleashed
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Ride for Vengeance
abilities.effect: If any friendly Warrior Chamber units have been destroyed this battle: • You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit. • This unit has Strike-first if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Lightning Quick
abilities.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by Retreat abilities.

abilities.name: Shock Cavalry
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with both of the following units to be the target: • This unit. • A friendly unit that did not charge this turn.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Merciless Sentinels
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's attacks while it contests an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.

abilities.name: Star Falcon
abilities.declare: If this unit's Sanson Farstrider is on the battlefield, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Star-marked
abilities.effect: Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic while a Hunted enemy unit is on the battlefield. In addition, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks that target a Hunted enemy unit.

abilities.name: Astral Compass
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has the Hunted keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Shocking Strikes
abilities.effect: If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by attacks made with this unit's Shock Handaxes, subtract 1 from wound rolls for that enemy unit's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Charging Volley
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: This unit can immediately use a Shoot ability as if it were your shooting phase, but all of its attacks must target that enemy unit. In addition, unit's Starstrike Javelins have Shoot in Combat this phase.

abilities.name: Coordinated Strike
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit's Hurricane Crossbows to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Vanguard Chamber units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Headshot
abilities.effect: If this unit has not used a Move ability this turn and was not set up this turn, for the rest of the turn, this unit can ignore the effects of the 'Guarded Hero' ability (Core Rules, 25.0) when picking targets for its shooting attacks.

abilities.name: Lightning Strikes
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's Celestial Greatswords for attacks that target an enemy unit that has 5 or more models.

abilities.name: Navigators of the Storm
abilities.effect: If an enemy unit had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's shooting attacks, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly Stormcast Eternals units that target that unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Hold the Shieldwall
abilities.effect: If this unit did not charge this turn and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit has Strike-first for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Taros
abilities.effect: This unit's Taros is a token. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place Taros next to it.

abilities.name: Harrying Aetherwing
abilities.declare: If any attacks made with this unit's Stormcaller Bow scored a critical hit this phase, pick an enemy unit targeted by those attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, place Taros next to the target. While Taros is placed next to an enemy unit, that enemy unit cannot use commands.
